db:select.doc:name: Check Duplicate Event
db:select.db:sql: SELECT event_id FROM inventory_movements WHERE event_id = :eventId LIMIT 1

set-payload.doc:name: Return Duplicate Result

db:select.doc:name: Read Current Inventory
db:select.db:sql: SELECT sku, location_code, quantity_on_hand, reserved_quantity, available_quantity, event_version, last_event_id, last_event_time, reorder_point, unit_of_measure FROM inventory_stock WHERE sku = :sku AND location_code = :locationCode LIMIT 1

set-variable.value: #[if (vars.currentInventory == null) null else vars.currentInventory.event_version as Number]
set-variable.doc:name: Preserve Expected Version

when.expression: #[vars.currentInventory != null and (vars.inventoryEvent.event.eventVersion as Number) <= (vars.currentInventory.event_version as Number)]

set-payload.doc:name: Return Stale Event

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var event = vars.inventoryEvent.event var available = (event.quantityOnHand as Number) - (event.reservedQuantity as Number) --- { sku: event.sku, locationCode: event.locationCode, quantityOnHand: event.quantityOnHand as Number, reservedQuantity: event.reservedQuantity as Number, availableQuantity: available, eventVersion: event.eventVersion as Number, eventId: event.eventId, eventTimestamp: event.eventTimestamp, sourceSystem: vars.inventoryEvent.sourceSystem, unitOfMeasure: event.unitOfMeasure, isValidStock: available >= 0 }

set-payload.doc:name: Return Invalid Stock

db:update.doc:name: Update Inventory With Optimistic Locking.
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE inventory_stock SET quantity_on_hand = :quantityOnHand, reserved_quantity = :reservedQuantity, available_quantity = :availableQuantity, event_version = :newVersion, last_event_id = :eventId, last_event_time = :eventTimestamp, source_system = :sourceSystem, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sku = :sku AND location_code = :locationCode AND event_version = :expectedVersion;
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ quantityOnHand: payload.quantityOnHand, reservedQuantity: payload.reservedQuantity, availableQuantity: payload.availableQuantity, newVersion: payload.eventVersion, eventId: payload.eventId, eventTimestamp: payload.eventTimestamp, sourceSystem: payload.sourceSystem, sku: payload.sku, locationCode: payload.locationCode, expectedVersion: payload.expectedVersion }]

db:select.doc:name: Re-read Inventory After Conflict.
db:select.db:sql: SELECT sku, location_code, quantity_on_hand, reserved_quantity, available_quantity, event_version, last_event_id, last_event_time, reorder_point, unit_of_measure FROM inventory_stock WHERE sku = :sku AND location_code = :locationCode LIMIT 1;

set-variable.value: #[if (vars.currentInventory == null) null else vars.currentInventory.event_version as Number]
set-variable.doc:name: Update Expected Version After Conflict

when.expression: #[vars.currentInventory != null and (vars.inventoryEvent.event.eventVersion as Number) <= (vars.currentInventory.event_version as Number)]

set-payload.doc:name: Return Stale Event After Conflict.
Return Version Conflict

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var event = vars.inventoryEvent.event var onHand = event.quantityOnHand as Number var reserved = event.reservedQuantity as Number var available = onHand - reserved --- { sku: event.sku, locationCode: event.locationCode, quantityOnHand: onHand, reservedQuantity: reserved, availableQuantity: available, eventId: event.eventId, eventVersion: event.eventVersion as Number, eventTimestamp: event.eventTimestamp, sourceSystem: vars.inventoryEvent.sourceSystem, unitOfMeasure: event.unitOfMeasure, movementType: event.movementType, expectedVersion: vars.expectedVersion, isValidStock: onHand >= 0 and reserved >= 0 and reserved <= onHand }

set-payload.doc:name: Invalid Stock After Conflict
